claims.text: Uncomp ABRS, adults: offer watchful waiting w.o abx, w assured f/u
claims.quote: Clinicians should offer watchful waiting (without antibiotics) for adults with uncomplicated ABRS with assurance of follow-up.
claims.locator: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update (AAO-HNSF, 2025), key action statements as reproduced by Guideline Central

claims.text: How long may depend on the factors and timing of the original Dx
claims.quote: The duration of watchful waiting may depend on the factors and timing under which the diagnosis was originally made.
claims.locator: Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis Update (AAO-HNSF, 2025), key action statements as reproduced by Guideline Central
